_comment: Trace sample-line parity cases. Each is a system call whose short structural `summary` (of `answer`) is classified a success, and whose stored `sample_line` names an id that reads like an error marker. The line travels as its own field: the server keeps it out of `summary` (tests/unit/test_trace_sample_line_channel.py) and the UI shows it below the summary without classifying it (frontend/src/test/trace-sample-line.test.tsx). `appended_outcome` is how the UI classifier reads summary + blank line + sample line, which is why the line must not be appended. `record` is the sample record the engine renders `sample_line` from. `coverage_cases` are calls whose stored telemetry-coverage lines travel as their own field too: `outcome` is how the summary alone classifies, `prefixed_outcome` how coverage lines in front of it did.
